caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of quilted fabric rendered in shades of yellow. The upper section of the fabric features a pattern of diagonal lines intersecting to form a diamond grid, while the lower section contains an ornate design with curved lines, floral motifs, scrollwork, and leaf-like shapes. The boundary between the two sections is marked by a scalloped edge interwoven with swirling lines. The entire fabric piece is detailed with fine, textured lines to suggest stitching or embroidery. The fabric is placed against a plain, off-white background, with no other objects present in the composition. There is a small, subtle text inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Quilting on Silk (Detail)
